entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I bought a jersey a while back, and I finally tried it on for a long ride. It's the wrong size for me and feels way too tight. I was hoping I could start a return or an exchange.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, one moment. Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey. It looks like it was delivered about 57 days ago. Is that correct?
That sounds about right. I know it's been a bit. Is that a problem?

Not at all. For a standard item like this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this return for you right now. Would you prefer a refund or to exchange it for a different size?

Oh, perfect. I'd like to do an exchange for one size up. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of repackaging this and sending it back, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for my trouble? It would make ordering my next piece of gear a bit easier.

I understand your request, but our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on a standard size exchange. However, the return shipping is completely free, and I can email you the label right now. The moment the return is scanned by the carrier, we can ship out the new size for you.
Okay, that's fair. Free shipping both ways works for me. So you'll send the email with the label and I just drop it off?
That's correct. The email is on its way to you now. It will have all the instructions. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
